objections.objection: The record explicitly admits no code change, PR, or root-cause is described, yet the episode still proceeds to a closed/resolved post_state. Without any stated mechanism connecting the filler-store/GCell index mismatch to whatever changed in 'the latest version', there is no causal chain linking hypothesis to outcome at all — this is weaker than a typical unmeasured-fix case because even the nature of the fix is unknown, not just its magnitude.

The reporter's confirmation only establishes that the specific crash symptom (the GPL-0314 error) no longer reproduces on a later build; it does not establish that the underlying index/size mismatch was actually fixed versus, e.g., masked by unrelated changes to filler counts, GCell indexing, or placement flow in the intervening commits — a distinction the record cannot resolve.

Given that the fix mechanism is entirely unknown (no commit, no PR, no explanation), a mid-range confidence of 0.5 is arguably still generous for an episode whose causal core is empty; the gaps field's own admissions support a lower value.
